title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
title_zh: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems to facilitate social interactions, in which social attribution , the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents’ social behaviors, plays a critical role. Such reasoning processes involve the judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and social cognition, represented by Attribution Theory, it is still underexplored in the AI and computing community, and LLM social reasoning in particular. This paper aims to advance the understanding of LLM in a fundamental social aspect by providing the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs’ performances in making responsibility and blame judgments, as well as their internal mechanisms underlying such judgments. Specifically, guided by attribution theory, we first construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset constructed based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. At a deep level, some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地部署在社会技术系统中，以促进社会互动。在此过程中，社会归因——即将外部事件归因于智能体社会行为的原因和理由的推理过程——发挥着关键作用。 这类推理过程涉及对智能体的社会原因、责任以及归咎/功劳的判断。 尽管归因模型在社会心理学和社会认知领域已有广泛研究（以归因理论为代表），但在人工智能和计算领域，尤其是LLM的社会推理方面，这一主题仍缺乏深入探索。 本文旨在通过首次系统性地探索LLM的社会归因，推动对LLM在基础社会层面的理解。 我们的工作聚焦于责任与归咎的归因，考察当前LLM在执行责任与归咎判断时的表现，以及这些判断背后的内部机制。 具体而言，我们以归因理论为指导，首先构建了一个社会归因基准数据集：该数据集包含一个基于归因理论研究经典场景的“情境”子集，以及一个基于真实世界社会叙事的“现实”子集，共生成7,639个责任/归咎判断问题。 在此基础上，我们对32种代表性LLM和5种基础非LLM基线模型进行了评估。 为了进一步探索LLM判断过程背后的内部机制，我们开发了一种基于探测的方法论，用于研究5个关键归因维度在LLM潜在空间中的表示，并分析这些表示对人类社会归因中相应维度的影响一致性。 我们的研究结果表明，当前LLM与人类的责任和归咎判断存在可测量但尚未完全一致的结果，且这种一致性随模型规模的增大而增强。 在更深层次上，某些归因维度可以从LLM隐藏状态中的特定位置系统性地解码出来，且这些维度对最终判断的影响与人类归因理论所揭示的规律一致。 数据集及相关代码可在 https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench 获取。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks ranging from natural language understanding and generation, interactive conversations, to complex problem solving ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) . With the continuous progress of advanced AI technologies, LLMs have shown broader impacts in the social realm and been integrated into sociotechnical applications, such as social simulation ( Park et al., 2023 ) , human-AI interactions ( Hadan et al., 2025 ) , social learning ( Goindani and Neville, 2019 ) , and normative reasoning ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) . In such settings, inaccurate responsibility or blame attribution can lead to concrete harms, for example, in legal and social service assistance, incorrect attribution may mislead responsibility judgments; in mental health and healthcare settings, incorrect blame may lead to victim-blaming or unsafe advice ( Dahl et al., 2024 ) ; and in content moderation or community governance, incorrect blame may cause victims to be treated as violators ( Moore et al., 2025 ) . A critical topic underlying these diverse applications is the reliance on social attribution ( Gratch et al., 2006 ; Malle, 2022 ) , the social reasoning process that centers on attributing the occurrence of external events to the causes and reasons of agents’ social behaviors, and assigning responsibility, blame, or credit to the involved agents in rich social interactions. Such social inference reflects how agents make sense of and act on the social world around them, and lies at the heart of social intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在从自然语言理解与生成、交互式对话到复杂问题求解等任务中展现了强大的能力（Achiam 等人，2023）。 随着先进人工智能技术的持续进步，LLM 在社会领域展现出更广泛的影响，并被整合到社会技术型应用中，例如社会模拟（Park 等人，2023）、人与 AI 的互动（Hadan 等人，2025）、社会学习（Goindani 和 Neville，2019）以及规范推理（Yuan 等人，2024）。 在此类情境中，不准确的責任或歸咎分配可能導致具體危害：例如，在法律與社會服務援助領域，錯誤的歸因可能誤導責任判斷；在心理健康與醫療照護環境中，錯誤的歸咎可能導致受害者被責怪或收到不安全建議（Dahl 等人，2024）；而在內容審管或社區治理中，錯誤的歸咎可能使受害者被當成違規者（Moore 等人，2025）。 這些多樣化應用背後的一個關鍵主題，是對社會歸因（Gratch 等人，2006；Malle，2022）的依賴——這是一種社會推理過程，其核心在於將外部事件的發生歸因於智能體社會行為的原因與動機，並為參與豐富社會互動的智能體分配責任、歸咎或功勞。 這種社會推論反映了智能體如何理解並回應周圍的社會世界，也是社會智慧的核心的所在。

paragraphs.en: Social attribution is a fundamental field of research in social psychology and social cognition, and has been well-studied. For decades, researchers have established Attribution Theory ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) as the dominant theoretical framework. In these theoretical models, the central theme involves the judgments of social cause, responsibility and blame/credit. Such judgments are not driven by outcomes alone, but systematically shaped by a set of key attributional dimensions, such as intention , voluntariness , foreknowledge , controllability , and obligation , that characterize agents’ mental states and the nature of their involvement in social events. In computational research on social attribution, previous work has built computational frameworks to model this judgment process grounded in attribution theory ( Mao et al., 2011 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ) . More recently, several works propose to leverage LLMs primarily for normative or legal reasoning ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Guha et al., 2023 ) . Despite the importance of social attribution in theoretical foundations and broader applications, it is still underexplored in the computing/information science community, and especially in LLM social reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 社会归因是社会心理学和社会认知领域的一个基础研究方向，并且已经得到了广泛研究。 几十年来，研究人员已将归因理论（Shaver, 1985；Weiner, 1995；Malle 等，2014）确立为主要的理论框架。 在这些理论模型中，核心主题涉及对社会原因、责任以及责备/功劳的判断。 这类判断并非仅由结果驱动，而是由一系列关键的归因维度系统性地塑造的，例如意图、自愿性、预知、可控性和义务，这些维度描述了智能体的心理状态及其参与社会事件的性质。 在社会归因的计算研究中，先前的工作已经构建了基于归因理论的计算框架来模拟这一判断过程（Mao 等，2011；Mao 和 Gratch，2012）。 近期，一些研究提出主要利用大型语言模型进行规范性或法律推理（Yuan 等，2024；Guha 等，2023）。 尽管社会归因在理论基础和更广泛应用中具有重要意义，但在计算/信息科学领域，尤其是在大型语言模型的社会推理方面，这一主题仍未被充分探索。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we focus on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs’ performances in making responsibility and blame judgments, as well as their internal mechanisms underlying such judgments. Specifically, to explore current LLMs’ performances in making responsibility and blame judgments, we raise the first research question: How accurate are current LLMs in attributing responsibility and blame compared to human judgments? Furthermore, given the judgment process and the intermediate cognitive variables (i.e., attribution dimensions) clearly identified by attribution theory, it remains unclear whether a similar process exists in LLM social reasoning and to what extent LLM social attribution resembles that of human judgments in the internal social and cognitive mechanisms described in attribution theory. Therefore, we raise deeper research questions: Are social attribution dimensions identified in human theory actually represented in LLMs’ internal hidden states? and further: Do the influences of LLMs’ dimension representations on judgments align with human social attribution theory?
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们关注责任与归因问题，考察当前大型语言模型（LLM）在做出责任与归因判断方面的表现，以及这些判断背后的内部机制。 具体而言，为了探索当前大型语言模型在责任与归因判断方面的表现，我们提出第一个研究问题：与人类判断相比，当前的大型语言模型在归因责任与过错方面的准确性如何？ 此外，鉴于归因理论已经明确识别出判断过程以及中间认知变量（即归因维度），目前尚不清楚大型语言模型的社会推理中是否存在类似的过程，以及其社会归因在归因理论所描述的内部社会与认知机制上，与人类判断有多大的相似性。 因此，我们提出更深入的研究问题：人类理论中识别出的社会归因维度是否确实体现在大型语言模型的内部隐藏状态中？更进一步的问题是：大型语言模型对这些维度表示的影响是否与其判断结果一致，并且是否符合人类的社会归因理论？

paragraphs.en: To answer these research questions, we conduct one of the first systematic studies of social attribution in LLM reasoning. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a bilingual social attribution benchmark consisting of two complementary subsets. One subset is built from classic scenarios in attribution theory research based on vignette paradigm, enabling controlled manipulation of attribution dimensions across different inter-agent relations and social situations. The other subset is constructed from real-world social narratives to introduce more realistic and ambiguous social attribution scenarios. After expert annotation and filtering, the benchmark contains 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs, including 9 closed-source and 23 open-source models, and compare them with 5 basic non-LLM baselines. This evaluation addresses RQ1 by measuring both exact agreement with human responsibility/blame labels and relative agreement in multi-agent attribution rankings.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这些研究问题，我们开展了一项关于大型语言模型（LLM）推理中社会归因的首批系统性研究之一。 在归因理论的指导下，我们构建了一个双语社会归因基准数据集，该数据集由两个互补的子集组成。 其中一个子集基于情景范式，从归因理论研究的经典场景中构建而成，从而能够跨不同智能体间关系和社会情境对归因维度进行受控操控。 另一个子集则从现实世界的社会叙事中构建，以引入更具真实性和模糊性的社会归因场景。 经过专家标注和筛选后，该基准数据集包含 7,639 个责任/归咎判断问题。 在此基础上，我们评估了 32 款代表性的大型语言模型（LLM），包括 9 款闭源模型和 23 款开源模型，并将其与 5 种非 LLM 的基础模型进行了比较。 这项评估通过衡量与人类责任/归咎标签的完全一致度以及多智能体归因排名中的相对一致度，来解答研究问题一（RQ1）。

sents.en: To answer these research questions, we conduct one of the first systematic studies of social attribution in LLM reasoning.
sents.zh: 为了回答这些研究问题，我们开展了一项关于大型语言模型（LLM）推理中社会归因的首批系统性研究之一。

sents.en: Guided by attribution theory, we construct a bilingual social attribution benchmark consisting of two complementary subsets.
sents.zh: 在归因理论的指导下，我们构建了一个双语社会归因基准数据集，该数据集由两个互补的子集组成。

sents.en: One subset is built from classic scenarios in attribution theory research based on vignette paradigm, enabling controlled manipulation of attribution dimensions across different inter-agent relations and social situations.
sents.zh: 其中一个子集基于情景范式，从归因理论研究的经典场景中构建而成，从而能够跨不同智能体间关系和社会情境对归因维度进行受控操控。

sents.en: The other subset is constructed from real-world social narratives to introduce more realistic and ambiguous social attribution scenarios.
sents.zh: 另一个子集则从现实世界的社会叙事中构建，以引入更具真实性和模糊性的社会归因场景。

sents.en: After expert annotation and filtering, the benchmark contains 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions.
sents.zh: 经过专家标注和筛选后，该基准数据集包含 7,639 个责任/归咎判断问题。

sents.en: On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs, including 9 closed-source and 23 open-source models, and compare them with 5 basic non-LLM baselines.
sents.zh: 在此基础上，我们评估了 32 款代表性的大型语言模型（LLM），包括 9 款闭源模型和 23 款开源模型，并将其与 5 种非 LLM 的基础模型进行了比较。

sents.en: This evaluation addresses RQ1 by measuring both exact agreement with human responsibility/blame labels and relative agreement in multi-agent attribution rankings.
sents.zh: 这项评估通过衡量与人类责任/归咎标签的完全一致度以及多智能体归因排名中的相对一致度，来解答研究问题一（RQ1）。

paragraphs.en: To answer the second and third research questions of investigating the internal mechanisms in LLM social attribution, we leverage a dimension-level probing framework to examine the existence of dimension representations in LLM hidden states and their influences on the final judgments. In mechanistic interpretability for LLMs, a rich toolbox of well-established methods has been developed ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2025 ) . Among them, the probing technique is typically adopted in studying dimension-based cognitive or psychological representations within LLMs, mainly because it enables a quantitative alignment between theory-derived dimensional variables and LLM hidden states ( Tak et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2025 ) . In our probing-based framework, to examine the existence of dimension representations, we first train linear probes on the hidden states, leveraging the annotations of the key attribution dimensions from our constructed benchmark. We then conduct an empirical analysis across layers and dimensions to investigate the representation strength of each dimension at different latent regions. To further examine the influences of dimension representations on responsibility and blame judgments, we directionally vary the LLM hidden states along specific dimension representations to quantify the extent to which the final judgments are affected, and conduct rigorous hypothesis testing to verify the consistency of these impacts with the human judgment patterns indicated in attribution theory.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答关于探究大型语言模型（LLM）社会归因内部机制的第二和第三个研究问题，我们采用了一种维度级探测框架，以检验LLM隐藏状态中是否存在维度表示及其对最终判断的影响。 在LLM的机制可解释性领域，已经发展出一套丰富的成熟方法工具（Huben等，2024；Zhang等，2025；Zhang，2025）。 其中，探测技术通常被用于研究LLM内部的基于维度的认知或心理表示，这主要是因为它能够实现对理论推导出的维度变量与LLM隐藏状态之间的量化对齐（Tak等，2025；Kang等，2025；Zhang，2025）。 在我们的探测框架中，为了检验维度表示的存在性，我们首先基于所构建基准测试中的关键归因维度的标注信息，在隐藏状态上训练线性探测器。 接着，我们对不同层和维度进行经验分析，以探究每个维度在不同潜在区域中的表示强度。 为了进一步考察维度表示对责任与归咎判断的影响，我们沿着特定的维度表示方向性地调整LLM的隐藏状态，以量化最终判断受影响的程度，并开展严格的假设检验，验证这些影响是否与归因理论所揭示的人类判断模式一致。

paragraphs.en: Our research contributions and findings are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究贡献与发现总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We focus on the fundamental research problem of LLM social attribution with wide applications, and present one of the first systematic studies on LLM responsibility and blame judgments as well as the internal mechanisms underlying such judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们聚焦于具有广泛应用的 LLM 社会归因这一基础研究问题，并提出了首批关于 LLM 责任与归咎判断及其内在机制的系统性研究之一。

paragraphs.en: We construct a bilingual social attribution benchmark consisting of a controlled vignette subset and a realistic social scenario subset, and conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation on 32 representative LLMs and 5 classical baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个双语社会归因基准，该基准包含一个受控情境子集和一个真实社会场景子集，并对 32 款代表性大型语言模型（LLM）和 5 款经典基线模型进行了全面的实证评估。

paragraphs.en: We develop a latent space dimension probing methodology that employs a probe-based technique to quantify the decodability of attribution dimensions and dimension-level influences, and on this basis, investigate the existence of dimensional representations in LLM hidden states and their influence mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种潜在空间维度探测方法，该方法采用基于探针的技术来量化归因维度的可解码性以及维度层面的影响，并在此基础上研究大型语言模型（LLM）隐藏状态中是否存在维度表示及其影响机制。

paragraphs.en: Our empirical findings demonstrate that specific attribution dimensions are represented within the latent space of LLMs, and their influences on LLM final judgments align with those of human social attribution theory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实证研究结果表明，特定的归因维度存在于大型语言模型（LLM）的潜在空间中，且这些维度对LLM最终判断的影响与人类社会归因理论中的影响一致。

paragraphs.en: LLMs for normative judgments. Recent research systematically evaluates LLMs’ attribution-related behaviors in social contexts ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Benchmarks typically address two categories of judgment: (1) social-norm judgments, using everyday, context-dependent rules of thumb to evaluate whether models generate or select norm-consistent explanations and behavioral recommendations ( Forbes et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) ; and (2) legal judgments, grounded in statutes, precedents, and legal reasoning, assessing performance and reliability in legal question answering, case analysis, and decision recommendation ( Guha et al., 2023 ; Fei et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) . These studies primarily adopt a normative or prescriptive perspective. We instead take a descriptive perspective, modeling systematic patterns in LLM responsibility and blame judgments and evaluating their alignment with human judgments, without assuming that human judgments conform to universal principles of rationality. Our benchmark further annotates five theory-derived attribution dimensions to examine the intermediate variables underlying these judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 用于规范性判断的大语言模型。 近期研究系统性地评估了大语言模型在社会情境中与归因相关的行为（Xu et al., 2024）。 基准测试通常涉及两类判断：（1）社会规范判断，即利用日常、依赖具体情境的经验法则，评估模型是否生成或选择符合规范的解释和行为建议（Forbes et al., 2020；Jiang et al., 2021；Yuan et al., 2024；Agarwal et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2025；Ji et al., 2025；Chakraborty et al., 2025）；以及（2）法律判断，即基于法律法规、判例和法律推理，评估模型在法律问答、案例分析和决策推荐方面的表现与可靠性（Guha et al., 2023；Fei et al., 2024；Dai et al., 2025）。 这些研究主要采用规范性或规定性视角。 我们则采取描述性视角，对大语言模型在责任与归咎判断中的系统性模式进行建模，并评估其与人类判断的一致性，而无需假设人类判断符合普遍理性原则。 我们的基准测试还进一步标注了五个源自理论框架的归因维度，以考察这些判断背后的中间变量。

paragraphs.en: LLM Probing for Mechanism Exploration. Probing measures the decodability of target variables from LLM hidden states using lightweight predictors ( Belinkov and Glass, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Studies examine factual and relational knowledge ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hernandez et al., 2024 ) , instruction following ( Heo et al., 2025 ) , and truth-related signals ( Orgad et al., 2025 ) , sometimes combining representation analysis with activation interventions to assess their influence on outputs. Social and cognitive studies investigate modality reliance through prompt perturbations ( Qi et al., 2023 ) , stereotypical patterns in emotion attribution ( Plaza-del-Arco et al., 2024 ) , and latent value structures ( Kang et al., 2025 ) . More directly related to our methodology, Tak et al. (2025) probe theory-derived cognitive appraisal dimensions and intervene on their representations to influence emotion inference. Other studies examine the decodability and steerability of self- and personality-related constructs ( Ju et al., 2025 ) and ideological positions ( Zhang, 2025 ) . These findings motivate theory-guided probing and interventions for LLM social reasoning; however, to the best of our knowledge, prior work has not specifically probed attribution dimensions underlying responsibility and blame judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 通过探针探索机制。 探针利用轻量级预测器，衡量从 LLM 隐藏状态中解码目标变量的可能性（Belinkov 和 Glass，2019；Belinkov，2022）。 相关研究考察了事实性与关系性知识（Meng 等，2022；Hernandez 等，2024）、指令遵循（Heo 等，2025）以及与真相相关的信号（Orgad 等，2025），有时还会将表征分析与激活干预相结合，以评估它们对输出的影响。 社会与认知研究通过提示扰动（Qi 等，2023）、情绪归因中的刻板模式（Plaza-del-Arco 等，2024）以及潜在的价值结构（Kang 等，2025），探究了模型对模态的依赖。 与我们方法更直接相关的研究是 Tak 等 （2025）的研究，他们探测了理论推导出的认知评估维度，并通过干预这些表征来影响情绪推断。 其他研究则考察了与自我和人格相关的建构（Ju 等，2025）以及意识形态立场（Zhang，2025）的可解码性与可操控性。 这些发现为 LLM 社会推理的理论引导型探针与干预提供了动机；然而，据我们所知，先前的工作尚未专门探测责任与归咎判断背后的归因维度。

paragraphs.en: Responsibility and blame judgments. Responsibility judgment assesses the extent to which an agent is accountable for an event, considering causal involvement, controllability, and mitigating factors such as coercion or lack of foreknowledge. Blame judgment further assesses whether the agent deserves moral criticism, taking justifications and excuses into account. Responsibility thus presupposes causality but is not reducible to it; similarly, responsibility is a prerequisite for blame but does not necessarily entail blameworthiness ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 责任与归咎判断。 责任判断评估智能体对某一事件应负责任的程度，需考虑其因果关联、可控性，以及胁迫或缺乏预见性等缓解因素。 归咎判断则进一步评估该智能体是否应受到道德批判，同时会考量其正当化理由和辩解。 因此，责任以因果关系为前提，但无法简化为因果关系；同理，责任是归咎的前提条件，但并不必然意味着应受责备（Shaver, 1985; Weiner, 1995）。

paragraphs.en: Attribution theories and dimensions. Classic attribution theories characterize responsibility and blame judgments through structured assessments of attribution dimensions, which capture agents’ causal involvement, mental states, and situational constraints ( Weiner, 1995 ; Shaver, 1985 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) ; see Appendix A.1 for detailed accounts and illustrations. Drawing on these theories, we focus on five dimensions (Appendix A.2 ):
paragraphs.zh: 归因理论与维度。 经典的归因理论通过结构化地评估归因维度来描述责任与归咎判断，这些维度涵盖了智能体的因果参与、心理状态以及情境限制（Weiner, 1995；Shaver, 1985；Malle et al., 2014）；详细阐述与图示请参见附录 A.1。 基于这些理论，我们重点关注五个维度（附录 A.2）：

sents.en: Attribution theories and dimensions.
sents.zh: 归因理论与维度。

sents.en: Classic attribution theories characterize responsibility and blame judgments through structured assessments of attribution dimensions, which capture agents’ causal involvement, mental states, and situational constraints ( Weiner, 1995 ; Shaver, 1985 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) ; see Appendix A.1 for detailed accounts and illustrations.
sents.zh: 经典的归因理论通过结构化地评估归因维度来描述责任与归咎判断，这些维度涵盖了智能体的因果参与、心理状态以及情境限制（Weiner, 1995；Shaver, 1985；Malle et al., 2014）；详细阐述与图示请参见附录 A.1。

sents.en: Drawing on these theories, we focus on five dimensions (Appendix A.2 ):
sents.zh: 基于这些理论，我们重点关注五个维度（附录 A.2）：

paragraphs.en: Intention. Whether the agent deliberately performed the focal action according to a goal or plan. Here, intention concerns the action itself, not the outcome it produces.
paragraphs.zh: 意图。 智能体是否根据某个目标或计划有意执行了核心行为。 此处，意图关注的是行为本身，而非其产生的结果。

sents.en: Intention.
sents.zh: 意图。

sents.en: Whether the agent deliberately performed the focal action according to a goal or plan.
sents.zh: 智能体是否根据某个目标或计划有意执行了核心行为。

sents.en: Here, intention concerns the action itself, not the outcome it produces.
sents.zh: 此处，意图关注的是行为本身，而非其产生的结果。

paragraphs.en: Voluntariness. Whether the agent acted freely rather than under external coercion, authority, or situational pressure, even without an explicit threat.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿性。 智能体是出于自由意志行动，而非受到外部胁迫、权威或情境压力（即使没有明确的威胁）。

sents.en: Voluntariness.
sents.zh: 自愿性。

sents.en: Whether the agent acted freely rather than under external coercion, authority, or situational pressure, even without an explicit threat.
sents.zh: 智能体是出于自由意志行动，而非受到外部胁迫、权威或情境压力（即使没有明确的威胁）。

paragraphs.en: Foreknowledge. Whether the agent knew or, given their epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have foreseen the outcome. Foreknowledge typically increases attributed responsibility and blame ( Shaver, 1985 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 预知。 该智能体是否知道，或者根据其认知和知识条件，是否应当预见这一结果。 预知通常会增加被归因的责任和责备（Shaver, 1985）。

sents.en: Foreknowledge.
sents.zh: 预知。

sents.en: Whether the agent knew or, given their epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have foreseen the outcome.
sents.zh: 该智能体是否知道，或者根据其认知和知识条件，是否应当预见这一结果。

sents.en: Foreknowledge typically increases attributed responsibility and blame ( Shaver, 1985 ) .
sents.zh: 预知通常会增加被归因的责任和责备（Shaver, 1985）。

paragraphs.en: Controllability. Whether the agent had the practical capacity to prevent the outcome, including the necessary means, skills, or opportunity.
paragraphs.zh: 可控性。 智能体是否具备阻止结果发生的实际能力，包括必要的手段、技能或机会。

sents.en: Controllability.
sents.zh: 可控性。

sents.en: Whether the agent had the practical capacity to prevent the outcome, including the necessary means, skills, or opportunity.
sents.zh: 智能体是否具备阻止结果发生的实际能力，包括必要的手段、技能或机会。

paragraphs.en: Obligation. Whether the agent had a duty to prevent the negative outcome given the situation and social relationship, a key consideration in attributing responsibility or blame for unintentional outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 义务。 在特定情境和社会关系下，该智能体是否有责任阻止负面结果的发生，这是归因于非故意性结果的責任或责备时的一个关键考量因素。

sents.en: Obligation.
sents.zh: 义务。

sents.en: Whether the agent had a duty to prevent the negative outcome given the situation and social relationship, a key consideration in attributing responsibility or blame for unintentional outcomes.
sents.zh: 在特定情境和社会关系下，该智能体是否有责任阻止负面结果的发生，这是归因于非故意性结果的責任或责备时的一个关键考量因素。

paragraphs.en: To address the lack of a dedicated data resource for systematically studying LLM social attribution, we first construct a benchmark that pairs human responsibility/blame judgments with theory-derived attribution dimensions. The benchmark comprises two complementary subsets, Vignette and Reality , supporting both behavioral evaluation and analysis of the representations underlying these judgments. Figure 1 summarizes construction and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决缺乏专门用于系统研究大型语言模型社会归因的数据资源这一问题，我们首先构建了一个基准数据集，该数据集将人类的责任/归咎判断与理论推导出的归因维度相匹配。 该基准数据集包含两个互补的子集：Vignette 和 Reality，既支持行为评估，也支持对这些判断所依赖的表征进行分析。 图 1 总结了其构建过程与评估方法。

sents.en: To address the lack of a dedicated data resource for systematically studying LLM social attribution, we first construct a benchmark that pairs human responsibility/blame judgments with theory-derived attribution dimensions.

sents.en: The benchmark comprises two complementary subsets, Vignette and Reality , supporting both behavioral evaluation and analysis of the representations underlying these judgments.
sents.zh: 该基准数据集包含两个互补的子集：Vignette 和 Reality，既支持行为评估，也支持对这些判断所依赖的表征进行分析。

sents.en: Figure 1 summarizes construction and evaluation.
sents.zh: 图 1 总结了其构建过程与评估方法。

paragraphs.en: The Vignette subset draws on classic scenarios from psychological attribution research, preserving their theoretical grounding while using structured narratives to precisely control attribution dimensions. Following the vignette paradigm ( Baguley et al., 2022 ) , we construct 11 templates spanning eight scenario types and three inter-agent relation categories: general interactions, vicarious blame, and command–obedience chains. Dimension values constrained by each role structure are fixed, while the remaining values are systematically varied. To reduce surface shortcuts, we diversify narrative details and phrasing, randomize names and genders, and avoid explicit dimension labels. Each scenario involves multiple agents, with a separate responsibility question and a separate blame question for each agent. Appendix B.1 details the construction. The Reality subset captures realistic and ambiguous social interactions through narratives posted by real users, complementing the controlled Vignette settings. Following the story-reconstruction approach of Forbes et al. (2020) , we select Reddit AITA posts with clear negative outcomes and reconstruct them into concise narratives. LLM-assisted preprocessing and inspection remove irrelevant or harmful content and identifying information, replacing identities with fictional names. For each scenario, we select a single target agent and ask separate responsibility and blame questions about that agent. Appendices B.2 and B.3 specify the models, processing steps, and prompts. Both subsets are constructed in Chinese and English.
paragraphs.zh: Vignette子集借鉴了心理学归因研究中的经典场景，在保留其理论基础的同时，通过结构化叙事精确控制归因维度。遵循vignette范式（Baguley等，2022），我们构建了11个模板，涵盖八种场景类型和三种智能体间关系类别：一般互动、代理归咎以及命令–服从链。由每种角色结构所约束的维度值被固定，而其余值则进行系统性变化。为减少表面化的捷径判断，我们对叙事细节和措辞进行了多样化处理，随机化了姓名和性别，并避免了显性的维度标签。每个场景都涉及多个智能体，并为每个智能体单独设置一个责任问题和一个归咎问题。附录B.1详细描述了其构建过程。Reality子集则通过真实用户发布的叙事，捕捉了现实且模糊的社会互动，从而对受控的Vignette设定形成补充。遵循Forbes等（2020）的故事重构方法，我们挑选了Reddit上具有明确负面结果的AITA帖子，并将其重构为简洁的叙事。在大型语言模型辅助的预处理和审查过程中，我们移除了无关或有害的内容以及身份识别信息，并用虚构姓名替代了真实身份。对于每个场景，我们选定一个单一的目标智能体，并针对该智能体分别提出责任问题和归咎问题。附录B.2和B.3详细说明了所用模型、处理步骤和提示词。两个子集均以中文和英文构建。

paragraphs.en: Data Example. During an artillery exercise, a general orders a strike through a platoon leader and a soldier. Both candidate buildings, A and B, are abandoned. The general, unaware of workers cleaning inside A, allows the platoon leader to choose either building. The platoon leader knows about the workers but orders a strike on A. The soldier also knows about them. The strike injures the workers. Question. To what extent should the general (platoon leader/soldier) be held responsible (be blamed)? Choose from [high, medium, low, no].
paragraphs.zh: 数据示例。 在一次炮兵演习中，一名将军通过一名排长和一名士兵下令发动攻击。 候选建筑 A 和 B 都是废弃的。 将军不知道有工人在 A 楼内打扫，因此允许排长选择任意一栋建筑。 排长知道有工人在里面，但仍下令攻击 A 楼。 士兵也知道有工人在里面。 这次攻击导致工人受伤。问题： 将军（排长/士兵）应在多大程度上承担责任（被归咎）？ 从 [高、中、低、无] 中选择。

paragraphs.en: Each question i i concerns one agent, scenario, language, and task m ∈ { responsibility , blame } m\in\{\textit{responsibility},\textit{blame}\} , with judgment a i , m ∈ 𝒜 = { no , low , medium , high } a_{i,m}\in\mathcal{A}=\{\texttt{no},\texttt{low},\texttt{medium},\texttt{high}\} . The dimension set 𝒦 \mathcal{K} comprises intention, voluntariness, foreknowledge, controllability, and obligation. For each dimension k ∈ 𝒦 k\in\mathcal{K} , y i , k ∈ { 0 , 1 , ∅ } y_{i,k}\in\{0,1,\varnothing\} denotes a binary value or an unspecified/inapplicable label. Dimension values are set during Vignette construction and human-annotated for Reality . Two psychology experts independently annotate judgments, treating languages and tasks separately and viewing only scenarios and questions, with dimension labels hidden. Before filtering, the annotators achieve 86.8% exact agreement overall and a mean Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.826 across the two tasks and languages, supporting the consistency of the annotations. We retain only questions for which both annotators assign the same judgment label, yielding 7,639 questions. See Appendices B.4 , B.5 , B.6 , and B.7 for annotation and dataset details.

paragraphs.en: To address RQ1, we use two metrics to quantify agreement between LLM and human responsibility and blame judgments. Outputs are canonicalized to 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (Appendix C.3 ). Accuracy is the proportion of valid predictions that exactly match human labels, measuring agreement on the absolute level of responsibility or blame assigned to an agent. Mapping ( no , low , medium , high ) (\texttt{no},\texttt{low},\texttt{medium},\texttt{high}) to ( 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 ) (0,1,2,3) through r r , we also compute Spearman correlation between predicted and human agent rankings within each Vignette scenario, assigning average ranks to ties. This metric measures agreement on which agents are more responsible or blameworthy relative to others, even when the predicted judgment levels differ from human labels. We report the mean correlation across scenarios. Invalid predictions are excluded from accuracy, and scenarios containing them are excluded from correlation (Appendix C.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决研究问题1（RQ1），我们使用两种指标来量化大型语言模型（LLM）与人类在责任与归咎判断上的一致性。 输出结果被标准化为 𝒜 \mathcal{A}（附录 C.3）。 准确率是指有效预测中与人类标签完全一致的比例，用于衡量对智能体所承担的责任或应受责备程度的绝对水平上的一致性。 通过将 ( no , low , medium , high ) (\texttt{no},\texttt{low},\texttt{medium},\texttt{high}) 映射到 ( 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 ) (0,1,2,3)（通过 r r），我们还计算了每个 Vignette 场景中预测智能体排名与人类排名之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数，并对并列情况赋予平均排名。 该指标衡量的是哪些智能体相对于其他智能体更具责任或更应受责备方面的一致性，即使预测的判断水平与人类标签存在差异。 我们报告了各场景中的平均相关系数。 无效预测被排除在准确率计算之外，而包含这些无效预测的场景则被排除在相关性计算之外（附录 C.4）。

paragraphs.en: Probes are trained separately by language and subset to avoid train–test overlap between translations. Vignette uses eight-fold leave-one-scenario-type-out cross-validation: each fold tests one type and trains on the other seven, grouping all occurrences of that type across agent relations. This tests decoding on unseen scenario types and reduces performance inflation from shared event backgrounds and templates. Reality uses 10-fold random cross-validation (Appendix D.2 ). Within each language–subset run, we summarize decodability by the unweighted mean of fold balanced accuracies, ( Recall 0 + Recall 1 ) / 2 (\mathrm{Recall}_{0}+\mathrm{Recall}_{1})/2 . Decodability measures recovery of binary dimension labels; benchmark accuracy concerns responsibility/blame judgments. We report decodability as a percentage, with 50% indicating chance.
paragraphs.zh: 探测器按语言和子集分别训练，以避免不同语言翻译之间出现训练集与测试集的重叠。 Vignette 采用八折“留一场景类型”交叉验证：每折测试一种类型，并在其余七种类型上进行训练，其中同一类型的所有实例均跨智能体关系进行分组。 此举用于测试对未见过的场景类型的解码能力，并减少因共享事件背景和模板而导致的性能虚高问题。 Reality 采用十折随机交叉验证（附录 D.2）。 在每个语言-子集运行中，我们通过各折平衡准确率的无加权平均值来总结可解码性，即 (Recall 0 + Recall 1) / 2 (\mathrm{Recall}_{0}+\mathrm{Recall}_{1})/2。 可解码性衡量的是二元维度标签的恢复能力；基准准确率则涉及责任/归因判断。 我们将可解码性以百分比形式报告，其中 50% 表示随机猜测水平。

paragraphs.en: To address RQ3, we investigate whether the influence of latent attribution-dimension representations on LLMs’ final responsibility and blame judgments is consistent with the patterns of human social attribution described by attribution theory ( Shaver, 1985 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . To assess this consistency, we intervene along each dimension’s representation and compare the resulting judgment changes with theory-derived directional expectations (Appendix A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决研究问题3，我们探究了潜在归因维度表示对大型语言模型最终的责任和归咎判断的影响，是否与归因理论所描述的人类社会归因模式一致（Shaver, 1985；Mao and Gratch, 2012；Malle et al., 2014）。 为了评估这种一致性，我们对每个维度的表示进行干预，并将由此产生的判断变化与理论推导出的方向性预期进行比较（附录A.3）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 32 LLMs: nine closed-source LLMs from the Claude, Doubao Seed, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Kimi, MiMo, and Step families, and 23 open-source LLMs from the Llama, Phi, GPT-oss, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen, Gemma, GLM, and InternLM families. The open-source models span 0.5–120B parameters; Appendix C.1 provides the full model list and inference settings. We evaluate each LLM with four prompt strategies: Direct (answer without reasoning), CoT (reason step by step), Self-reflection (review and revise an initial judgment), and Theory-guided (analyze the five attribution dimensions before judging). For comparison, we evaluate five non-LLM models: Random Stratified (sample labels according to their frequencies), Majority Class (predict the most frequent label), Heuristic Rule (score textual keywords), Attribution-Theory Rule (apply theory-based rules to annotated dimensions), and mBERT Classifier (predict labels with fine-tuned multilingual BERT). Performance is measured by accuracy and Spearman’s ρ \rho , as defined in Section 4 . Prompt templates and non-LLM model details are provided in Appendices C.2 and C.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 32 个 LLM：包括来自 Claude、Doubao Seed、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Kimi、MiMo 和 Step 系列的 9 个闭源 LLM，以及来自 Llama、Phi、GPT-oss、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen、Gemma、GLM 和 InternLM 系列的 23 个开源 LLM。 这些开源模型的参数规模从 0.5B 到 120B 不等；附录 C.1 提供了完整的模型列表和推理设置。 我们采用四种提示策略来评估每个 LLM：直接回答（无需推理）、CoT（逐步推理）、自我反思（审查并修正初始判断）以及理论引导（在做出判断前分析五个归因维度）。 为了进行比较，我们还评估了五种非 LLM 模型：随机分层模型（根据标签频率进行采样）、多数类模型（预测出现频率最高的标签）、启发式规则模型（对文本关键词进行评分）、归因理论规则模型（将基于理论的规则应用于已标注的维度）以及 mBERT 分类器（使用微调后的多语言 BERT 预测标签）。 性能通过准确率和斯皮尔曼等级相关系数 ρ \rho 来衡量，具体定义见第 4 节。 提示模板和非 LLM 模型的详细信息请参见附录 C.2 和 C.5。

paragraphs.en: To understand how attribution dimensions are represented and influence LLM judgments, we examine their decodability in hidden states and whether their influences on judgments align with human attribution theory. We use DeepSeek-R1-1.5B, Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B as backbones with CoT prompts, following the methods in Section 4.2 . Reported decodability plots recompute balanced accuracy from held-out predictions pooled across languages and subsets (Appendix D.2 ). Hyperparameters, implementation, and testing details are provided in Appendices D.4 and D.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解归因维度如何被表示以及它们如何影响 LLM 的判断，我们研究了这些维度在隐藏状态中的可解码性，并探究了它们对判断的影响是否与人类归因理论一致。 我们使用 DeepSeek-R1-1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 作为基础模型，并结合 CoT 提示，遵循第 4.2 节中的方法。 报告的可解码性图表基于跨语言和子集合并的预留预测重新计算了平衡准确率（附录 D.2）。 超参数、实现细节和测试详情见附录 D.4 和 D.5。

sents.en: To understand how attribution dimensions are represented and influence LLM judgments, we examine their decodability in hidden states and whether their influences on judgments align with human attribution theory.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 compares agreement with human judgments across models, averaging each LLM’s results over the four prompting strategies. Grok-4.3 achieves the highest scores on both metrics when averaged across responsibility and blame, with 58.00% accuracy and ρ = 0.627 \rho=0.627 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 比较了各模型与人类判断的一致性，并对每种 LLM 在四种提示策略上的结果进行了平均。 在对责任与归因两个指标取平均值时，Grok-4.3 在这两项指标上均取得了最高得分，准确率为 58.00%，相关系数 ρ = 0.627 \rho=0.627 。

sents.en: Figure 3 compares agreement with human judgments across models, averaging each LLM’s results over the four prompting strategies.
sents.zh: 图 3 比较了各模型与人类判断的一致性，并对每种 LLM 在四种提示策略上的结果进行了平均。

sents.en: Grok-4.3 achieves the highest scores on both metrics when averaged across responsibility and blame, with 58.00% accuracy and ρ = 0.627 \rho=0.627 .
sents.zh: 在对责任与归因两个指标取平均值时，Grok-4.3 在这两项指标上均取得了最高得分，准确率为 58.00%，相关系数 ρ = 0.627 \rho=0.627 。

paragraphs.en: For most models, accuracy is higher on responsibility than on blame, whereas Spearman’s ρ \rho shows the opposite pattern. It is because assigning a blame level requires finer judgments of moral severity and mitigating circumstances: models may preserve relative differences in blame among agents while differing from humans on the precise level assigned.
paragraphs.zh: 对于大多数模型而言，其在责任判定上的准确率高于归咎判定，而斯皮尔曼的 ρ \rho 则呈现出相反的模式。 这是因为确定归咎程度需要对道德严重性和减轻情节做出更精细的判断：模型可能在保持智能体之间归咎程度的相对差异的同时，在具体的归咎水平上与人类存在差异。

paragraphs.en: The supervised mBERT classifier achieves accuracy comparable to selected 4–8B LLMs: 43.47% on responsibility, versus 43.13% for Gemma3-4B, and 31.60% on blame, versus 33.23% for Llama3.1-8B (Appendix Table 15 ). Its limited accuracy may reflect difficulty learning agent-specific roles and obligations from the available supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 有监督的 mBERT 分类器实现了与部分 4–8B LLM 相当准确率：在责任判断上为 43.47%，而 Gemma3-4B 为 43.13%；在归咎判断上为 31.60%，而 Llama3.1-8B 为 33.23%（附录表 15）。 其有限的准确率可能反映出，从现有监督数据中难以学习智能体特定的角色与义务。

paragraphs.en: Across the 23 open-source models, both accuracy and ranking agreement increase with log-scale parameter count (Figure 4 ). The fitted slopes are positive for both metrics ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), with R 2 = 0.766 R^{2}=0.766 for accuracy and R 2 = 0.806 R^{2}=0.806 for ρ \rho . However, differences in model families and training preclude attributing this trend to parameter count alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在 23 个开源模型中，准确率和排名一致性都随着参数数量的对数级增长而提高（图 4）。 拟合后的斜率在这两项指标中均为正值（p < 0.001 p<0.001），其中准确率的 R² = 0.766 R^{2}=0.766，ρ \rho 的 R² = 0.806 R^{2}=0.806。 然而，不同模型家族和训练方式之间的差异使得无法将这一趋势完全归因于参数数量本身。

sents.en: Across the 23 open-source models, both accuracy and ranking agreement increase with log-scale parameter count (Figure 4 ).
sents.zh: 在 23 个开源模型中，准确率和排名一致性都随着参数数量的对数级增长而提高（图 4）。

sents.zh: 拟合后的斜率在这两项指标中均为正值（p < 0.001 p<0.001），其中准确率的 R² = 0.766 R^{2}=0.766，ρ \rho 的 R² = 0.806 R^{2}=0.806。

paragraphs.en: These results answer RQ1 by showing measurable but incomplete agreement with human judgments, with higher agreement associated with larger open-source models.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果通过展示与人类判断存在可衡量但尚未完全一致的情况，回答了研究问题1（RQ1），其中一致性较高的情况与规模更大的开源模型相关。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the decodability of attribution dimensions at the label-token prediction step across five models, both judgment tasks, and normalized layer depths.
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了在标签-词元预测阶段，五个模型、两种判断任务以及归一化层深度下各归因维度的可解码性。

paragraphs.en: Attribution dimensions are consistently decodable from hidden states, with most middle and later layers scoring above chance. Intention and obligation show the highest decodability, approaching 90% in Llama-3.1-8B and the Qwen models. Foreknowledge is weaker, particularly in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B, while voluntariness and controllability vary more across models. Responsibility and blame show similar patterns in dimension strength and layerwise variation.
paragraphs.zh: 归因维度始终可以从隐藏状态中解码，其中大多数中间层和后续层的得分均高于随机水平。 意图和义务的解码能力最强，在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen 模型中接近 90%。 预知能力的解码能力较弱，尤其是在 DeepSeek-R1-1.5B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 中，而自愿性和可控性在不同模型间的差异则更大。 责任与归责在维度强度及逐层变化方面表现出相似的模式。

sents.en: Attribution dimensions are consistently decodable from hidden states, with most middle and later layers scoring above chance.
sents.zh: 归因维度始终可以从隐藏状态中解码，其中大多数中间层和后续层的得分均高于随机水平。

sents.en: Intention and obligation show the highest decodability, approaching 90% in Llama-3.1-8B and the Qwen models.
sents.zh: 意图和义务的解码能力最强，在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen 模型中接近 90%。

sents.en: Foreknowledge is weaker, particularly in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B, while voluntariness and controllability vary more across models.
sents.zh: 预知能力的解码能力较弱，尤其是在 DeepSeek-R1-1.5B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 中，而自愿性和可控性在不同模型间的差异则更大。

sents.en: Responsibility and blame show similar patterns in dimension strength and layerwise variation.
sents.zh: 责任与归责在维度强度及逐层变化方面表现出相似的模式。

paragraphs.en: Decodability generally increases from early to middle layers and remains high across later layers. Some dimensions plateau or decline slightly near the output, with peak decodability often occurring before the final layer. This pattern is consistent with attribution information becoming easier to read out as the model integrates the scenario context.
paragraphs.zh: 可解码性通常从早期层到中期层逐渐增强，并在后续各层中保持较高水平。 某些维度在接近输出层时会趋于平稳或略有下降，而可解码性的峰值通常出现在最后一层之前。 这种模式与归因信息随着模型整合场景上下文而变得更容易被读取出来的现象一致。

sents.en: Decodability generally increases from early to middle layers and remains high across later layers.
sents.zh: 可解码性通常从早期层到中期层逐渐增强，并在后续各层中保持较高水平。

sents.en: Some dimensions plateau or decline slightly near the output, with peak decodability often occurring before the final layer.
sents.zh: 某些维度在接近输出层时会趋于平稳或略有下降，而可解码性的峰值通常出现在最后一层之前。

sents.en: This pattern is consistent with attribution information becoming easier to read out as the model integrates the scenario context.
sents.zh: 这种模式与归因信息随着模型整合场景上下文而变得更容易被读取出来的现象一致。

paragraphs.en: Sanity checks further support these findings (see Appendix Figures 10 – 14 ). Across all five models, the original probes outperform the shuffled-label control, which stays near chance, and generally outperform the 64-dimensional random-projection control. For Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, they also exceed the scenario-text TF-IDF control across most layers.
paragraphs.zh: 合理性检查进一步支持这些发现（参见附录中的图 10–14）。 在所有五个模型中，原始探针的表现均优于标签打乱对照组（后者表现接近随机水平），并且通常也优于 64 维随机投影对照组。 对于 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，它们在大多数层面上的表现也超过了场景文本 TF-IDF 对照组。

sents.en: Sanity checks further support these findings (see Appendix Figures 10 – 14 ).
sents.zh: 合理性检查进一步支持这些发现（参见附录中的图 10–14）。

sents.en: Across all five models, the original probes outperform the shuffled-label control, which stays near chance, and generally outperform the 64-dimensional random-projection control.
sents.zh: 在所有五个模型中，原始探针的表现均优于标签打乱对照组（后者表现接近随机水平），并且通常也优于 64 维随机投影对照组。

sents.en: For Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, they also exceed the scenario-text TF-IDF control across most layers.
sents.zh: 对于 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，它们在大多数层面上的表现也超过了场景文本 TF-IDF 对照组。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, these results provide evidence that the evaluated LLMs encode linearly decodable information about attribution dimensions, with strength varying across dimensions, models, and layers.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题2（RQ2），这些结果提供了证据，表明所评估的大型语言模型（LLM）编码了关于归因维度的线性可解码信息，且其强度因维度、模型和层而异。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows whether interventions along attribution-dimension representations shift responsibility and blame judgments in the directions predicted by attribution theory. Intention and obligation show the most consistent effects: at 60% and 80% relative depth, both dimensions satisfy the directional tests in all five models and both tasks. These effects hold against the unedited baseline and both intervention controls. This pattern also matches the high decodability of intention and obligation observed in the preceding analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了沿归因维度表示的干预措施是否会将责任与归咎判断向归因理论所预测的方向转移。 意图和义务表现出最一致的影响：在相对深度为 60% 和 80% 时，这两个维度在所有五个模型和两项任务中均通过了方向性检验。 这些影响在与未经编辑的基线以及两种干预对照相比时依然成立。 这一模式也与前述分析中观察到的意图和义务的高可解码性相符。

sents.en: Figure 6 shows whether interventions along attribution-dimension representations shift responsibility and blame judgments in the directions predicted by attribution theory.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了沿归因维度表示的干预措施是否会将责任与归咎判断向归因理论所预测的方向转移。

sents.en: Intention and obligation show the most consistent effects: at 60% and 80% relative depth, both dimensions satisfy the directional tests in all five models and both tasks.
sents.zh: 意图和义务表现出最一致的影响：在相对深度为 60% 和 80% 时，这两个维度在所有五个模型和两项任务中均通过了方向性检验。

sents.en: These effects hold against the unedited baseline and both intervention controls.
sents.zh: 这些影响在与未经编辑的基线以及两种干预对照相比时依然成立。

sents.en: This pattern also matches the high decodability of intention and obligation observed in the preceding analysis.
sents.zh: 这一模式也与前述分析中观察到的意图和义务的高可解码性相符。

paragraphs.en: Theory-aligned effects are concentrated in the middle and later layers, particularly between 40% and 80% relative depth. The 60% depth has the broadest support, with 33 of 50 settings passing the tests, compared with six at 20% depth and nine at the final layer. Llama-3.2-1B retains several significant effects at the final layer, while the other models show fewer.
paragraphs.zh: 与理论一致的效果主要集中在中间和较后的层中，尤其是在相对深度为 40% 到 80% 的区间内。 60% 的深度层支持最广泛，50 个设置中有 33 个通过了测试，而 20% 深度层仅有 6 个通过，最终层则有 9 个通过。 Llama-3.2-1B 在最终层仍保留了几种显著效果，而其他模型则表现出较少的效果。

sents.en: Theory-aligned effects are concentrated in the middle and later layers, particularly between 40% and 80% relative depth.
sents.zh: 与理论一致的效果主要集中在中间和较后的层中，尤其是在相对深度为 40% 到 80% 的区间内。

sents.en: The 60% depth has the broadest support, with 33 of 50 settings passing the tests, compared with six at 20% depth and nine at the final layer.
sents.zh: 60% 的深度层支持最广泛，50 个设置中有 33 个通过了测试，而 20% 深度层仅有 6 个通过，最终层则有 9 个通过。

sents.en: Llama-3.2-1B retains several significant effects at the final layer, while the other models show fewer.
sents.zh: Llama-3.2-1B 在最终层仍保留了几种显著效果，而其他模型则表现出较少的效果。

paragraphs.en: The remaining dimensions show more variation across models and tasks. Foreknowledge produces significant effects on both tasks in the Llama models, while the Qwen models show significant effects only on responsibility. Voluntariness passes the tests in all five models at selected intermediate layers, including both tasks at 60% and 80% depth in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B. Controllability has the fewest significant results, appearing at isolated layers.
paragraphs.zh: 其余维度在不同模型和任务中表现出更多差异。 在 Llama 模型中，预先知识对两项任务都产生了显著影响，而 Qwen 模型仅在责任任务上表现出显著影响。 在所有五个模型的选定中间层中，自愿性均通过了测试，包括 DeepSeek-R1-1.5B 在 60% 和 80% 深度处的两项任务。 可控性的显著结果最少，仅出现在孤立的层中。

sents.en: The remaining dimensions show more variation across models and tasks.
sents.zh: 其余维度在不同模型和任务中表现出更多差异。

sents.en: Foreknowledge produces significant effects on both tasks in the Llama models, while the Qwen models show significant effects only on responsibility.
sents.zh: 在 Llama 模型中，预先知识对两项任务都产生了显著影响，而 Qwen 模型仅在责任任务上表现出显著影响。

sents.en: Voluntariness passes the tests in all five models at selected intermediate layers, including both tasks at 60% and 80% depth in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B.
sents.zh: 在所有五个模型的选定中间层中，自愿性均通过了测试，包括 DeepSeek-R1-1.5B 在 60% 和 80% 深度处的两项任务。

sents.zh: 可控性的显著结果最少，仅出现在孤立的层中。

paragraphs.en: For RQ3, the intervention results support theory-aligned influences most consistently for intention and obligation, while alignment for other dimensions depends on the model, task, and layer.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题3，干预结果最一致地支持了与理论相符的影响因素对意图和义务的作用，而其他维度的理论一致性则取决于模型、任务和层。

paragraphs.en: The appendices report full LLM and non-LLM results ( E.1 , E.2 ), valid-output rates ( E.3 ), scenario- and dimension-level breakdowns ( E.4 ), decodability sanity checks ( F.1 ), earlier-token decodability and influence ( F.2 , G.1 ), and intervention-strength sensitivity ( G.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 附录报告了完整的 LLM 和非 LLM 结果（E.1、E.2）、有效输出率（E.3）、场景和维度级别的细分（E.4）、可解码性合理性检查（F.1）、早期词元可解码性与影响（F.2、G.1），以及干预强度敏感性（G.2）。

paragraphs.en: To understand social attribution as a fundamental aspect of social reasoning, we present the first systematic investigation of LLM responsibility and blame judgments. Our benchmark comprises a Vignette subset of classic attribution scenarios and a Reality subset of real-world social narratives. We evaluate 32 LLMs and develop a framework to probe the representations underlying their judgments. Closed-source models generally outperform open-source models, whose agreement with human judgments is positively associated with model size. Across five probed models, attribution dimensions are decodable from hidden states, especially intention and obligation. Interventions on these dimensions produce the most consistent shifts predicted by attribution theory, especially in middle and later layers. Effects of other dimensions vary across models, tasks, and layers. Together, these findings connect LLM social attribution behavior with internal representations of factors identified in human attribution theory.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将社会归因理解为社会推理的一个基本方面，我们首次系统性地研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在责任与归咎判断方面的表现。 我们的基准测试包含一个经典归因场景的“情境”子集和一个真实世界社会叙事的“现实”子集。 我们对 32 个大型语言模型进行了评估，并开发了一个框架来探究其判断背后的内部表示。 闭源模型通常表现优于开源模型，而开源模型与人类判断的一致性与其模型规模呈正相关。 在五个受测模型中，归因维度可以从隐藏状态中被解码出来，尤其是意图和义务这两个维度。 对这些维度的干预产生了与归因理论预测最为一致的变化，尤其是在中间和较深的网络层中。 其他维度的影响在不同模型、任务和网络层中存在差异。 综合来看，这些发现将大型语言模型的社会归因行为与其内部表示的人类归因理论中所识别的因素联系了起来。

sents.en: To understand social attribution as a fundamental aspect of social reasoning, we present the first systematic investigation of LLM responsibility and blame judgments.
sents.zh: 为了将社会归因理解为社会推理的一个基本方面，我们首次系统性地研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在责任与归咎判断方面的表现。

sents.en: Our benchmark comprises a Vignette subset of classic attribution scenarios and a Reality subset of real-world social narratives.
sents.zh: 我们的基准测试包含一个经典归因场景的“情境”子集和一个真实世界社会叙事的“现实”子集。

sents.en: We evaluate 32 LLMs and develop a framework to probe the representations underlying their judgments.
sents.zh: 我们对 32 个大型语言模型进行了评估，并开发了一个框架来探究其判断背后的内部表示。

sents.en: Closed-source models generally outperform open-source models, whose agreement with human judgments is positively associated with model size.
sents.zh: 闭源模型通常表现优于开源模型，而开源模型与人类判断的一致性与其模型规模呈正相关。

sents.en: Across five probed models, attribution dimensions are decodable from hidden states, especially intention and obligation.
sents.zh: 在五个受测模型中，归因维度可以从隐藏状态中被解码出来，尤其是意图和义务这两个维度。

sents.en: Interventions on these dimensions produce the most consistent shifts predicted by attribution theory, especially in middle and later layers.
sents.zh: 对这些维度的干预产生了与归因理论预测最为一致的变化，尤其是在中间和较深的网络层中。

sents.en: Effects of other dimensions vary across models, tasks, and layers.
sents.zh: 其他维度的影响在不同模型、任务和网络层中存在差异。

sents.en: Together, these findings connect LLM social attribution behavior with internal representations of factors identified in human attribution theory.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现将大型语言模型的社会归因行为与其内部表示的人类归因理论中所识别的因素联系了起来。

paragraphs.en: Attribution theories describe how perceivers connect an agent’s actions to an outcome and assess the agent’s responsibility and blameworthiness. These judgments are related but distinct: causal involvement does not by itself establish responsibility, and responsibility does not by itself establish blame. Assessments of control, mental states, coercion, and mitigating circumstances help explain why agents involved in the same negative event can receive different judgments ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ) . This distinction motivates our separate responsibility and blame tasks, as well as annotations of intermediate attribution dimensions rather than final judgments alone.
paragraphs.zh: 归因理论描述了感知者如何将智能体的行为与结果联系起来，并评估该智能体的责任与应受责备程度。 这些判断相互关联但各有不同：因果参与本身并不能确立责任，而责任本身也不能直接确立应受责备的程度。 对控制能力、心理状态、胁迫以及减轻情节的评估有助于解释为何参与同一负面事件的不同智能体可能获得不同的判断（Shaver, 1985；Weiner, 1995）。 这种区分促使我们分别设计责任与责备任务，并对中间阶段的归因维度进行标注，而不仅仅是最终判断。

sents.zh: 这种区分促使我们分别设计责任与责备任务，并对中间阶段的归因维度进行标注，而不仅仅是最终判断。

paragraphs.en: Weiner characterizes causal explanations through separable dimensions: the locus of causality , distinguishing internal from external causes; stability , describing whether a cause persists over time; and controllability , concerning whether the agent could have acted otherwise ( Weiner, 1985 ; Weiner, 1986 ) . In the responsibility model (Figure 7(a) ), perceivers first assess whether an outcome reflects personal or situational causality. When personal causality is implicated, they evaluate controllability and consider mitigating circumstances before assigning responsibility ( Weiner, 1995 ) . The model therefore distinguishes an agent’s causal contribution from the extent to which the agent can reasonably be held responsible for it.
paragraphs.zh: Weiner 通过可分离的维度来描述因果解释：因果性来源（区分内部原因与外部原因）、稳定性（描述某种原因是否随时间持续存在）以及可控性（涉及智能体是否本可以做出不同行为）（Weiner, 1985; Weiner, 1986）。 在责任模型中（图 7(a)），观察者首先评估某一结果反映的是个人因果性还是情境因果性。 当涉及个人因果性时，他们会在归因责任之前评估可控性并考虑减轻责任的情节（Weiner, 1995）。 因此，该模型区分了智能体的因果贡献与其应被合理追究责任的程度。

sents.zh: 因此，该模型区分了智能体的因果贡献与其应被合理追究责任的程度。

paragraphs.en: Shaver describes blame for a negative consequence as a structured assessment of responsibility-relevant variables ( Shaver, 1985 ; Shaver and Drown, 1986 ) . As illustrated in Figure 7(b) , the assessment begins by distinguishing human agency from impersonal causes. When human agency is involved, subsequent assessments concern whether the agent foresaw the outcome, intended it, and acted voluntarily rather than under coercion. Justifications and excuses can further mitigate blame. These distinctions explain why similar outcomes can support different judgments depending on the agent’s knowledge, intentions, and freedom of action. They also motivate treating responsibility and blame as separate targets: mitigating information can reduce blame even when responsibility remains.
paragraphs.zh: Shaver 将负面后果的归咎描述为对与责任相关的变量进行结构化评估（Shaver, 1985；Shaver 和 Drown, 1986）。 如图 7(b) 所示，该评估首先区分人类智能体的作用与非个人性原因。 当涉及人类智能体时，后续评估会关注该智能体是否预见结果、是否有意为之，以及其行动是出于自愿而非被迫。 正当化和辩解可以进一步减轻归咎程度。 这些区别解释了为何相似的结果可能因智能体的知识、意图和行动自由的不同而引发不同的判断。 这也促使我们将责任与归咎视为两个独立的目标：即便责任仍然存在，减轻责任的信息仍可能降低归咎程度。

sents.zh: Shaver 将负面后果的归咎描述为对与责任相关的变量进行结构化评估（Shaver, 1985；Shaver 和 Drown, 1986）。

paragraphs.en: The Path Model of Blame (PMoB) specifies when different information becomes relevant to blame judgments ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . After assessing causality, perceivers evaluate intentionality, which separates two subsequent paths (Figure 7(c) ). For intentional conduct, reasons and their justificatory force are central. For unintentional conduct, preventability becomes central, including whether the agent had an obligation and the capacity to prevent the outcome. New information can revise an earlier assessment and redirect the judgment along the other path. This conditional structure is particularly relevant to our inclusion of supervisory obligations and command–obedience relations: a social role can affect responsibility and blame even when the agent did not directly intend the negative outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 归咎路径模型（PMoB）明确了不同信息在何时会对归咎判断产生相关性（Malle 等，2014）。 在评估因果关系之后，观察者会评价行为的意图性，从而区分出两条后续路径（图7(c)）。 对于有意行为而言，行为理由及其正当化力量是核心。 对于无意行为而言，可预防性则成为核心因素，包括智能体是否负有义务以及是否具备防止结果发生的能力。 新信息可能会修正先前的评估，并将判断引导至另一条路径。 这种条件结构尤其与我们纳入的监督义务和命令-服从关系相关：即使智能体并未直接意图造成负面结果，其社会角色仍可能影响责任与归咎。

sents.en: The Path Model of Blame (PMoB) specifies when different information becomes relevant to blame judgments ( Malle et al., 2014 ) .
sents.zh: 归咎路径模型（PMoB）明确了不同信息在何时会对归咎判断产生相关性（Malle 等，2014）。

paragraphs.en: We select five dimensions that are recurrent in attribution accounts and can be represented explicitly in controlled scenarios or annotated in reconstructed narratives. The operationalizations support comparisons across scenarios while preserving distinctions that would be obscured by a single overall judgment. They do not reproduce every construct or dependency in any one theory. In particular, causality provides part of the scenario context, whereas the five annotated dimensions describe mental states, constraints, capacities, and obligations associated with a target agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了五个在归因解释中反复出现、且能够在受控情境中明确呈现或在重构的叙述中标注出来的维度。 这些操作化方法支持跨情境的比较，同时保留了单一总体判断可能会掩盖的差异。 它们并未再现任何单一理论中的所有建构或依赖关系。 具体而言，因果关系提供了部分情境背景，而五个标注的维度则描述了与目标智能体相关的心理状态、限制、能力和义务。

sents.en: We select five dimensions that are recurrent in attribution accounts and can be represented explicitly in controlled scenarios or annotated in reconstructed narratives.
sents.zh: 我们选择了五个在归因解释中反复出现、且能够在受控情境中明确呈现或在重构的叙述中标注出来的维度。

sents.en: The operationalizations support comparisons across scenarios while preserving distinctions that would be obscured by a single overall judgment.
sents.zh: 这些操作化方法支持跨情境的比较，同时保留了单一总体判断可能会掩盖的差异。

sents.en: They do not reproduce every construct or dependency in any one theory.
sents.zh: 它们并未再现任何单一理论中的所有建构或依赖关系。

sents.en: In particular, causality provides part of the scenario context, whereas the five annotated dimensions describe mental states, constraints, capacities, and obligations associated with a target agent.
sents.zh: 具体而言，因果关系提供了部分情境背景，而五个标注的维度则描述了与目标智能体相关的心理状态、限制、能力和义务。

paragraphs.en: We operationalize intention at the level of the focal action: whether the agent deliberately performed it according to a goal or plan. This is action-intention , which need not imply a purpose to bring about the eventual negative outcome. Some attribution accounts use intention in the latter, outcome-directed sense ( Shaver, 1985 ; Shaver and Drown, 1986 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . Maintaining the distinction allows the benchmark to vary deliberate action and foreknowledge separately. Their conjunction represents acting while foreseeing a consequence, without equating foresight with a desire to produce that consequence ( Mao et al., 2011 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在核心行动层面将意图具体化：即智能体是否根据某个目标或计划有意执行了该行动。 这就是“行动-意图”，它并不必然意味着存在引发最终负面结果的目的。 某些归因理论采用后一种以结果为导向的意图概念（Shaver, 1985；Shaver and Drown, 1986；Malle et al., 2014）。 保持这种区分，使得基准测试能够分别考察有意行动与预知能力。 二者的结合代表在预见到某种后果的同时采取行动，但并不将预知等同于产生该后果的欲望（Mao et al., 2011）。

sents.en: We operationalize intention at the level of the focal action: whether the agent deliberately performed it according to a goal or plan.
sents.zh: 我们在核心行动层面将意图具体化：即智能体是否根据某个目标或计划有意执行了该行动。

sents.en: This is action-intention , which need not imply a purpose to bring about the eventual negative outcome.
sents.zh: 这就是“行动-意图”，它并不必然意味着存在引发最终负面结果的目的。

sents.en: Some attribution accounts use intention in the latter, outcome-directed sense ( Shaver, 1985 ; Shaver and Drown, 1986 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) .
sents.zh: 某些归因理论采用后一种以结果为导向的意图概念（Shaver, 1985；Shaver and Drown, 1986；Malle et al., 2014）。

sents.en: Maintaining the distinction allows the benchmark to vary deliberate action and foreknowledge separately.
sents.zh: 保持这种区分，使得基准测试能够分别考察有意行动与预知能力。

sents.en: Their conjunction represents acting while foreseeing a consequence, without equating foresight with a desire to produce that consequence ( Mao et al., 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 二者的结合代表在预见到某种后果的同时采取行动，但并不将预知等同于产生该后果的欲望（Mao et al., 2011）。

paragraphs.en: Voluntariness concerns whether the agent’s choice was substantially constrained by coercion, authority, or situational pressure. An explicit threat is not required: compliance with an authority can also constrain the choice. This dimension therefore separates freely chosen actions from actions performed under orders or pressure ( Shaver, 1985 ; Mao et al., 2011 ) . It is distinct from practical controllability. Following the distinction used in Mao et al. (2011) , information about control remains relevant when voluntariness is absent, because constrained choice alone does not specify which alternatives were practically available to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿性涉及智能体的选择是否受到胁迫、权威或情境压力的实质性限制。 并不一定需要明确的威胁：服从权威也可能对选择构成限制。 因此，这一维度将自由选择的行动与在命令或压力下执行的行为区分开来（Shaver, 1985；Mao 等，2011）。 它与实际可控性不同。 遵循 Mao 等（2011）中使用的区分方法， 即使缺乏自愿性，有关控制的信息仍然具有相关性，因为仅凭受限制的选择无法说明智能体实际上有哪些替代方案可供选择。

sents.en: Voluntariness concerns whether the agent’s choice was substantially constrained by coercion, authority, or situational pressure.
sents.zh: 自愿性涉及智能体的选择是否受到胁迫、权威或情境压力的实质性限制。

sents.en: An explicit threat is not required: compliance with an authority can also constrain the choice.
sents.zh: 并不一定需要明确的威胁：服从权威也可能对选择构成限制。

sents.en: This dimension therefore separates freely chosen actions from actions performed under orders or pressure ( Shaver, 1985 ; Mao et al., 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 因此，这一维度将自由选择的行动与在命令或压力下执行的行为区分开来（Shaver, 1985；Mao 等，2011）。

sents.en: It is distinct from practical controllability.
sents.zh: 它与实际可控性不同。

sents.en: Following the distinction used in Mao et al.
sents.zh: 遵循 Mao 等（2011）中使用的区分方法，

sents.en: (2011) , information about control remains relevant when voluntariness is absent, because constrained choice alone does not specify which alternatives were practically available to the agent.
sents.zh: 即使缺乏自愿性，有关控制的信息仍然具有相关性，因为仅凭受限制的选择无法说明智能体实际上有哪些替代方案可供选择。

paragraphs.en: Foreknowledge concerns whether the agent knew that the action could lead to the eventual outcome or, given the agent’s epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have been able to foresee it. The assessment thus depends on information available at the time of acting, rather than knowledge acquired after the event. Foreknowledge can increase attributed responsibility and blame even when the negative outcome was not the agent’s goal ( Shaver, 1985 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 预知性涉及智能体是否知道该行为可能导致最终结果，或者在智能体的认知和知识条件下，是否本应能够预见这一结果。 因此，评估取决于行动时可获得的信息，而非事件发生后获得的知识。 即使负面结果并非智能体的目标，预知性仍可能增加其被归因的责任和责备（Shaver, 1985）。

sents.en: Foreknowledge concerns whether the agent knew that the action could lead to the eventual outcome or, given the agent’s epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have been able to foresee it.
sents.zh: 预知性涉及智能体是否知道该行为可能导致最终结果，或者在智能体的认知和知识条件下，是否本应能够预见这一结果。

sents.en: The assessment thus depends on information available at the time of acting, rather than knowledge acquired after the event.
sents.zh: 因此，评估取决于行动时可获得的信息，而非事件发生后获得的知识。

sents.en: Foreknowledge can increase attributed responsibility and blame even when the negative outcome was not the agent’s goal ( Shaver, 1985 ) .
sents.zh: 即使负面结果并非智能体的目标，预知性仍可能增加其被归因的责任和责备（Shaver, 1985）。

paragraphs.en: We restrict controllability to the agent’s physical or practical ability to prevent the outcome, including relevant means, skills, and opportunities. In PMoB, preventability can also involve the capacity to foresee the outcome ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . We represent that epistemic component through foreknowledge, following the analytical separation of knowledge and control in our benchmark. This choice allows probing to distinguish knowing about a risk from having the practical capacity to avert it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将可控性限定为智能体在物理上或实际上阻止结果发生的能力，包括相关的途径、技能和机会。 在 PMoB 中，可预防性还可能涉及预见结果的能力（Malle 等，2014）。 我们通过在基准测试中对知识与控制进行解析性分离，以“预知”来表示这一认知要素。 这一选择使得探测能够区分“了解某种风险”与“具备实际能力去避免该风险”。

sents.en: We restrict controllability to the agent’s physical or practical ability to prevent the outcome, including relevant means, skills, and opportunities.
sents.zh: 我们将可控性限定为智能体在物理上或实际上阻止结果发生的能力，包括相关的途径、技能和机会。

sents.en: In PMoB, preventability can also involve the capacity to foresee the outcome ( Malle et al., 2014 ) .
sents.zh: 在 PMoB 中，可预防性还可能涉及预见结果的能力（Malle 等，2014）。

sents.en: We represent that epistemic component through foreknowledge, following the analytical separation of knowledge and control in our benchmark.
sents.zh: 我们通过在基准测试中对知识与控制进行解析性分离，以“预知”来表示这一认知要素。

sents.en: This choice allows probing to distinguish knowing about a risk from having the practical capacity to avert it.
sents.zh: 这一选择使得探测能够区分“了解某种风险”与“具备实际能力去避免该风险”。

paragraphs.en: Obligation concerns a duty of care, supervision, or prevention arising from the social situation and the agent’s role or relationship. It is particularly relevant to unintentional outcomes and omissions, where an agent may bear responsibility or blame despite not performing the action that directly produced the harm ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . Unlike broader uses of obligation that also include a subordinate’s duty to obey a superior ( Mao et al., 2011 ) , our operationalization concerns the duty to prevent the negative outcome. This boundary keeps supervisory responsibility distinct from obedience within a command relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 义务涉及因社会情境以及智能体的角色或关系而产生的关怀、监督或预防责任。 它与非故意的结果和疏忽尤其相关，在这种情况下，即使智能体并未直接实施造成损害的行为，也可能需要承担责任或受到指责（Malle 等，2014）。 与更广泛的义务用法不同——后者还包括下属服从上级的责任（Mao 等，2011）——我们的操作化定义关注的是防止负面结果发生的责任。 这一界限使监督责任与命令关系中的服从行为区分开来。

sents.en: Obligation concerns a duty of care, supervision, or prevention arising from the social situation and the agent’s role or relationship.
sents.zh: 义务涉及因社会情境以及智能体的角色或关系而产生的关怀、监督或预防责任。

sents.en: It is particularly relevant to unintentional outcomes and omissions, where an agent may bear responsibility or blame despite not performing the action that directly produced the harm ( Malle et al., 2014 ) .
sents.zh: 它与非故意的结果和疏忽尤其相关，在这种情况下，即使智能体并未直接实施造成损害的行为，也可能需要承担责任或受到指责（Malle 等，2014）。

sents.en: Unlike broader uses of obligation that also include a subordinate’s duty to obey a superior ( Mao et al., 2011 ) , our operationalization concerns the duty to prevent the negative outcome.
sents.zh: 与更广泛的义务用法不同——后者还包括下属服从上级的责任（Mao 等，2011）——我们的操作化定义关注的是防止负面结果发生的责任。

sents.en: This boundary keeps supervisory responsibility distinct from obedience within a command relationship.
sents.zh: 这一界限使监督责任与命令关系中的服从行为区分开来。

The definitions guide the construction of Vignette scenarios and the annotation of Reality narratives. The annotation materials and instructions are provided in Appendix B.4 .

paragraphs.en: Human attribution theory supplies a principled reference for selecting variables, constructing data, and specifying hypotheses about LLM judgments. It does not require assuming that LLMs instantiate human cognitive processes. This distinction is central to the study design: the benchmark measures agreement with human judgments, the probes measure whether theory-derived dimensions can be recovered from hidden states, and the interventions examine whether directions associated with those dimensions affect outputs in the expected way. Together, these analyses connect behavioral agreement to internal representations while allowing the model’s patterns to differ from the theoretical reference.
paragraphs.zh: 人类归因理论为选择变量、构建数据以及明确关于大型语言模型判断的假设提供了原则性的参考。 它并不要求我们假设大型语言模型实现了人类的认知过程。 这一区别是研究设计的核心：基准测试衡量与人类判断的一致性，探测任务衡量能否从隐藏状态中恢复出理论推导出的维度，而干预实验则检验与这些维度相关的方向是否以预期的方式影响输出。 这些分析共同将行为一致性联系到内部表征，同时允许模型的模式与理论参考有所不同。

paragraphs.en: In the negative-outcome scenarios considered here, intention, voluntariness, foreknowledge, practical control, and obligation provide reasons for assigning greater responsibility or blame when other relevant circumstances are comparable ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . We use this shared directional pattern to formulate an empirical expectation: strengthening the representation associated with a factor tends to increase the judgment, whereas weakening it tends to decrease the judgment. The positive probe direction corresponds to greater evidence for the factor’s presence under our operationalization.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究考虑的负面结果情境中，当其他相关情形相当时，意图、自愿性、预知、实际控制能力和义务构成了赋予更大责任或归咎的理由（Shaver, 1985；Weiner, 1995；Mao and Gratch, 2012；Malle et al., 2014）。 我们利用这种共同的方向性模式来构建一个经验性预期：强化与某一因素相关的表征往往会增强判断，而削弱该表征则往往会减弱判断。 在当前的操作化定义下，正向探测方向对应于该因素存在的更强证据。

sents.zh: 在本研究考虑的负面结果情境中，当其他相关情形相当时，意图、自愿性、预知、实际控制能力和义务构成了赋予更大责任或归咎的理由（Shaver, 1985；Weiner, 1995；Mao and Gratch, 2012；Malle et al., 2014）。

sents.zh: 在当前的操作化定义下，正向探测方向对应于该因素存在的更强证据。

paragraphs.en: These expectations are conditional tendencies, not universal additive rules. The classic models distinguish intentional and unintentional conduct and allow justifications, excuses, and social relationships to change the relevance of a factor. Deliberately performing an action, for example, does not by itself establish an intention to cause harm or settle blameworthiness. Our directional tests therefore assess aggregate consistency with the stated hypothesis within the benchmark and intervention setting; they do not require every individual scenario to follow the same monotonic relation. The inferential limits of this evidence are discussed in Appendix H.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 这些预期是条件性倾向，而非普适的加法规则。 经典模型区分了有意与无意的行为，并允许正当化理由、借口以及社会关系改变某一因素的相关性。 例如，故意执行某个行为本身并不会确立造成伤害的意图或决定其应受责备的程度。 因此，我们的方向性检验评估的是基准和干预设定中，整体结果与所陈述假设的一致性；它并不要求每个具体场景都遵循相同的单调关系。 此类证据的推论局限性在附录 H.2 中有讨论。

paragraphs.en: The two subsets serve complementary purposes. Vignette provides controlled scenarios in which attribution factors can be varied while preserving a coherent social context. Reality adds reconstructed everyday conflicts with less explicit and more ambiguous attribution information. Together, they support both evaluation against human judgments and probing of the dimensions underlying those judgments. This section details how the narratives, dimension labels, and judgment labels are obtained, and how agreement-based filtering changes the resulting sample.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个子集发挥着互补的作用。 Vignette 提供了受控的场景，在这些场景中，归因因素可以被调整，同时保持社会背景的一致性。 现实则加入了重构的日常冲突，其中归因信息不那么明确且更具模糊性。 它们共同支持了与人类判断的对比评估，以及对这些判断背后维度的探究。 本节详细说明了叙事、维度标签和判断标签是如何获取的，以及基于一致性的筛选如何改变最终的样本。

sents.en: The two subsets serve complementary purposes.
sents.zh: 这两个子集发挥着互补的作用。

paragraphs.en: The vignette method uses short hypothetical situations to vary explanatory factors systematically while retaining contextual detail ( Finch, 1987 ; Aguinis and Bradley, 2014 ; Baguley et al., 2022 ) . This makes it useful for relating LLM judgments to the factors studied in human social attribution. We construct scenarios around negative outcomes using canonical situations from attribution research ( Mao et al., 2011 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . Each template specifies agents, their relations, and attribution dimensions constrained by their roles. An inter-agent relation describes how agents are socially connected; a scenario type describes the event setting. The three relation categories are:
paragraphs.zh: 情景片段法通过简短的假设情境，在保留上下文细节的同时系统性地变化解释因素（Finch, 1987；Aguinis and Bradley, 2014；Baguley et al., 2022）。 这使得该方法能够将大型语言模型的判断与人类社会归因研究中考察的因素联系起来。 我们基于归因研究中的经典情境，围绕负面结果构建情景（Mao et al., 2011；Mao and Gratch, 2012；Malle et al., 2014）。 每个模板都明确了智能体、它们之间的关系，以及受其角色约束的归因维度。 智能体间关系描述了智能体之间的社会联系；情景类型则描述了事件背景。 三种关系类别是：

sents.zh: 每个模板都明确了智能体、它们之间的关系，以及受其角色约束的归因维度。

sents.en: An inter-agent relation describes how agents are socially connected; a scenario type describes the event setting.
sents.zh: 智能体间关系描述了智能体之间的社会联系；情景类型则描述了事件背景。

sents.en: The three relation categories are:
sents.zh: 三种关系类别是：

paragraphs.en: General : agents have no predefined social ties, or their ties do not entail responsibility or blame for another agent’s conduct.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言：智能体之间没有预定义的社会联系，或者它们之间的联系并不导致对另一智能体的行为负有责任或归咎。

paragraphs.en: Vicarious blame : agents occupy asymmetric social roles, such as parent–child or advisor–student, in which one agent has a supervisory obligation and may be held responsible for another agent’s behavior ( Malle et al., 2014 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 替代性归因：智能体占据非对称的社会角色，例如父母与子女或导师与学生，在这些关系中，一个智能体负有监督义务，并可能对他人的行为承担责任（Malle 等，2014）。

paragraphs.en: Commanding chain : agents are linked by command–obedience relations ( Mao et al., 2011 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 命令链：智能体通过命令–服从关系相互连接（Mao 等，2011；Mao 和 Gratch，2012）。

paragraphs.en: We generate instances by varying the remaining dimension values subject to these role constraints. For example, a parent–child relation introduces a supervisory obligation for the parent without requiring the parent and child to share the same intention. The template therefore constrains which combinations are meaningful; it does not require all five dimensions to vary independently for every agent. Table 1 lists the 11 relation-specific templates, their sources, event descriptions, fixed and variable dimensions, agent counts, and instance counts. These templates cover eight scenario types: Traffic Accident, Food Allergy, Company, Drowning, Laboratory, Family, Gunman, and Military Strike. Company occurs in all three relation categories, and Laboratory occurs in General and Vicarious Blame; each remains one scenario type across relations. These eight types define the held-out groups in the probing evaluation (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过调整其余维度值，并在这些角色约束条件下生成实例。 例如，父母与子女的关系为父母引入了监督义务，但并不要求父母和子女拥有相同的意图。 因此，该模板限制了哪些组合是有意义的；它并不要求每个智能体的五个维度都独立变化。 表1列出了11个特定于关系的模板，包括其来源、事件描述、固定和可变维度、智能体数量以及实例数量。 这些模板涵盖了八种场景类型：交通事故、食物过敏、公司、溺水、实验室、家庭、枪手和军事打击。 “公司”出现在所有三类关系中，“实验室”则出现在“一般责任”和“代位归责”中；每种类型在不同关系中仍保持为单一场景类型。 这八种类型定义了探测性评估（附录D.2）中的保留组。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the possibility that later probes exploit recurring names or sentence patterns instead of attribution-related information, we manually diversify the semantic details, syntactic structures, and narrative phrasing of the instances. Character names and genders are randomly generated for each instance. The descriptions also avoid trivially revealing the attribution variables through literal labels. These construction choices reduce repeated surface cues; the decodability controls separately examine how much information can still be recovered from surface text (Appendix D.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了降低后续探测可能利用重复出现的名称或句子模式，而非归因相关信息的可能性，我们手动对实例的语义细节、句法结构和叙述措辞进行了多样化处理。 每个实例中的人物名称和性别均为随机生成。 这些描述也避免了通过字面标签轻易暴露归因变量。 这些构建方式减少了重复的表面线索；可解码性控制则单独检验从表面文本中仍能恢复多少信息（附录 D.3）。

paragraphs.en: Controlled vignettes make the attribution factors explicit by design, but cannot capture all the ambiguity of everyday social narratives. The Reality subset complements them with interpersonal conflicts drawn from Reddit’s AITA community, 1 1 1 https://www.reddit.com/r/AmItheAsshole/ where users describe conflicts and ask for judgments about the parties involved. These narratives provide agents, actions, constraints, and outcomes in naturally occurring social contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的情景故事通过设计明确揭示了归因因素，但无法捕捉日常社会叙事中的所有模糊性。 “现实”子集则通过从 Reddit 的 AITA 社区（1 1 1 https://www.reddit.com/r/AmItheAsshole/）中选取的人际冲突来补充这些情景故事，在该社区中，用户会描述冲突并请求对涉事各方做出评判。 这些叙事在自然发生的社会情境中为智能体、行动、约束和结果提供了具体实例。

sents.en: Controlled vignettes make the attribution factors explicit by design, but cannot capture all the ambiguity of everyday social narratives.
sents.zh: 受控的情景故事通过设计明确揭示了归因因素，但无法捕捉日常社会叙事中的所有模糊性。

paragraphs.en: We select posts with clear negative outcomes and apply story reconstruction ( Forbes et al., 2020 ) to preserve their core events while removing irrelevant slang, dialogue, harmful or biased content, personal information, and metadata. Real identities are replaced with fictional names. The inclusion criteria require a self-contained narrative with at least two agents whose actions, roles, or knowledge are relevant to the negative outcome. For each reconstructed scenario, a single target agent is selected for separate responsibility and blame questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择具有明确负面结果的文章，并应用故事重构方法（Forbes 等人，2020），在保留其核心事件的同时，移除无关的俚语、对话、有害或偏见性内容、个人信息和元数据。 真实身份被替换为虚构名称。 纳入标准要求一个自成一体的叙述，其中至少包含两个智能体，它们的行为、角色或知识与负面结果相关。 对于每个重构后的场景，会选择一个单一的目标智能体，用于单独的责任和归咎问题。

sents.zh: 对于每个重构后的场景，会选择一个单一的目标智能体，用于单独的责任和归咎问题。

paragraphs.en: ChatGPT-5.4-mini 2 2 2 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4-mini performs cleaning and preprocessing. DeepSeek-V4-Pro 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro then checks the reconstructed narratives and filters those containing residual unwanted content. The prompts are provided in Appendix B.3 . English instances are translated into Chinese, yielding 864 agent–scenario pairs in each language before judgment annotation. This narrative-quality filtering precedes the separate judgment-agreement filtering in Appendix B.6 .

paragraphs.en: LLMs assist with reconstruction, cleaning, and quality inspection; they do not supply the final responsibility or blame labels. Those judgments are assigned by human experts. The reconstruction prompt takes an AITA post as input and returns the scenario background and agent descriptions. The inspection prompt specifies retention criteria and returns a decision with its reason. Both steps require valid JSON without additional prose.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 可协助进行重建、清理和质量检查，但不会提供最终的责任认定或归因标签。 这些判断由人类专家负责确定。 重建提示以 AITA 帖子作为输入，并返回场景背景及智能体描述。 检查提示会明确保留标准，并返回包含理由的决策结果。 这两个步骤均要求输出有效的 JSON，且不得附加任何额外文本。

paragraphs.en: We used the following prompt to transform raw Reddit posts into concise benchmark-style social scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了以下提示词，将原始的 Reddit 帖子转化为简洁的基准风格社交场景。

paragraphs.en: You are helping construct a dataset for social attribution research. Given a Reddit AITA post, rewrite it as a concise third-person story.
paragraphs.zh: 你正在帮助构建一个用于社会归因研究的数据集。 给定一篇 Reddit 上的 AITA 帖子，请将其改写为一个简洁的第三人称故事。

sents.en: You are helping construct a dataset for social attribution research.
sents.zh: 你正在帮助构建一个用于社会归因研究的数据集。

sents.en: Given a Reddit AITA post, rewrite it as a concise third-person story.
sents.zh: 给定一篇 Reddit 上的 AITA 帖子，请将其改写为一个简洁的第三人称故事。

paragraphs.en: Requirements: (1) Keep only the core plot related to the interpersonal conflict and the negative outcome. (2) Preserve the main agents, their actions, relevant knowledge, constraints, and consequences. (3) Remove irrelevant metadata, voting information, comments, edits, usernames, hyperlinks, and platform-specific expressions. (4) Remove slang, offensive wording, harmful or biased expressions, and private personal information. (5) Replace real or specific personal names with fictional names. (6) Do not add new facts, motives, or outcomes that are not supported by the original post. (7) Write the output in a neutral and clear style.
paragraphs.zh: 要求：(1) 仅保留与人际冲突及其负面结果相关的核心情节。 (2) 保留主要智能体、其行动、相关知识、约束条件及后果。 (3) 删除无关的元数据、投票信息、评论、编辑记录、用户名、超链接以及平台特定表达。 (4) 删除俚语、冒犯性措辞、有害或带有偏见的表达，以及私人个人信息。 (5) 将真实或具体的个人姓名替换为虚构姓名。 (6) 不得添加原文中未提及的新事实、动机或结果。 (7) 以中立且清晰的风格撰写输出内容。

sents.en: Requirements: (1) Keep only the core plot related to the interpersonal conflict and the negative outcome.
sents.zh: 要求：(1) 仅保留与人际冲突及其负面结果相关的核心情节。

sents.en: (2) Preserve the main agents, their actions, relevant knowledge, constraints, and consequences.

sents.en: (3) Remove irrelevant metadata, voting information, comments, edits, usernames, hyperlinks, and platform-specific expressions.

sents.en: (4) Remove slang, offensive wording, harmful or biased expressions, and private personal information.
sents.zh: (4) 删除俚语、冒犯性措辞、有害或带有偏见的表达，以及私人个人信息。

sents.en: (5) Replace real or specific personal names with fictional names.
sents.zh: (5) 将真实或具体的个人姓名替换为虚构姓名。

sents.zh: (6) 不得添加原文中未提及的新事实、动机或结果。

sents.en: (7) Write the output in a neutral and clear style.
sents.zh: (7) 以中立且清晰的风格撰写输出内容。

paragraphs.en: Return only a valid JSON object. Do not include markdown, comments, explanations, or any text outside the JSON object.
paragraphs.zh: 仅返回一个有效的 JSON 对象。 不要包含 Markdown、注释、解释或 JSON 对象之外的任何文本。

paragraphs.en: The JSON object must contain the following fields:
paragraphs.zh: JSON 对象必须包含以下字段：

paragraphs.en: story_background : a concise third-person description of the core event and the negative outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 故事背景：对核心事件及其负面结果的第三人称简要描述。

paragraphs.en: character_details : a list of short descriptions of the main agents. Each item should describe one agent’s relevant actions, knowledge, constraints, or role.
paragraphs.zh: character_details：主要智能体的简短描述列表。 每个条目应描述一个智能体的相关行为、知识、限制或角色。
